name: ESC Clermont
description:
Do you want to study at one of the popular business schools in France?

ESC Clermont Business School is one of the top 100 European business schools and is located in the city of Clermont-Ferrand, France.

About the University

ESC Clermont Business School was founded in 1919 and is an elite academic institution that admits students through an extremely competitive process.

It offers bachelor’s, master’s, Master’s in Management (MIM), and Doctorate of Business Administration (DBA) programs to learners.

These courses include Management, Digital Communication, Business Intelligence & Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Finance, and Digital Marketing, among many others.

Want to know more? Discover why the ESC Clermont Business School might be the place for you!

Why the ESC Clermont Business School?

  • ESC offers several courses and levels of study in multiple fields.
  • The university offers programs in French and English.
  • The university has students from all over the world, providing cultural immersion to students.

Student Life

ESC Clermont Business School offers a diverse and multicultural student body. Students can participate in various clubs and extracurricular activities besides their studies.

Students can also participate in several festival events, cultural competitions and activities organised by the university throughout the year.

Located in Clermont, the university provides a dynamic environment for students to study, with a low cost of living and a high quality of life.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: ESC Clermont Business School provides various accommodation options to students, depending on their budget and preferences. Students can choose from single rooms to shared apartments.

highlights.title: Sports
highlights.value:
The university’s Bureau Des Sports (BDS) is the association for all sports activities. This includes football, rugby, handball, basketball, volleyball, and all individual sports.

The BDS also organises several events such as the Semineige, allowing students to spend a weekend in a ski resort!
